_note: Settings used for the reported results. Record only: the scripts still define these values in code, so update this file if you change them there.

data.subset_rule: sort users by most recent interaction, keep each selected user's full history, stop before total interactions exceed the cap

evaluation.protocol: sampled ranking: 1 target + 99 negatives per user, same candidates for every model
evaluation.val_negatives_exclude: user's train items and the target
evaluation.test_negatives_exclude: user's train and val items and the target
evaluation.cold_target_filter: users whose target item never appears in train are dropped
evaluation.rank: number of negatives with a strictly higher score than the target (0-based)
evaluation.model_selection: epoch with the best val NDCG@10

popularity_baseline.score: number of interactions of the item in train

ncf_mlp.negative_sampling: resampled every epoch, uniform over train items the user has not interacted with

item_text_embedding.text_template: Title. Brand. Category. Price. Features (fields joined with '. ', missing fields skipped)
item_text_embedding.category_rule: drop the top-level 'Electronics', fall back to main_category if empty

rqvae.loss: reconstruction squared error + codebook loss + beta * commitment loss
rqvae.dead_code_reset: every epoch except the last 50, unused codes replaced by residuals of random items (8192 sampled)
rqvae.collision_handling: 4th code c4 = index within the group of items sharing (c1, c2, c3)

input.layout: [user token] + 4 tokens per history item, oldest to newest, padded at the end
input.train_samples: sliding window: every train interaction except each user's first is a target

training.loss: cross-entropy over the target item's 4 tokens (teacher forcing)
training.lr_schedule: linear warmup, then lr * sqrt(warmup_steps / step)
training.precision: fp16 + GradScaler on T4 (bf16 on GPUs with compute capability >= 8)
training.stop_reason: Colab compute units ran out; early stopping had not triggered

evaluation.score: sum of log-probabilities of the candidate's 4 tokens
